hook_lines: you don't spray it on yourself?!

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: Sprayed on ceilings/walls, not skin — a space-treatment mosquito spray
One spray covers about 15–26m² (roughly one room), lasts ~12 hours
Active ingredient: metofluthrin (pyrethroid) — no fire or electricity, once a day
Made by KINCHO, founded 1885 — Japan's original mosquito-coil pioneer brand

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 방 안에서 천장·벽 방향으로 스프레이를 한 번 누르는 사용 장면. 사람 얼굴은 안 나와도 되고 손+스프레이+분사 방향(천장 쪽)이 보이면 충분, 10~15초.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本金鸟KINCHO 灭蚊喷雾 喷天花板 使用测评

quotes.japanese: 1プッシュで蚊がいなくなるって…これが本当に蚊の姿を見なくなる。恐ろしいほどに全く見ない。
quotes.translation: One push and the mosquitoes are gone, they said... and it's true, you genuinely stop seeing them. It's almost frighteningly effective.

quotes.japanese: 窓を開けているのに蚊が入らない！
quotes.translation: The window's open and mosquitoes still don't get in!

quotes.japanese: 夕飯を食べ終わったらワンプッシュして、そのまま寝ても朝まで蚊に刺されることなく起きることができる
quotes.translation: I press it once after dinner, go straight to sleep, and wake up without a single bite.

quotes.japanese: ひと夏どころか、次の夏の分くらいまで持ったりします。
quotes.translation: It doesn't just last one summer — sometimes it carries over into the next one.
